import openpyxl
import pandas as pd

# Load the Excel file
excel_file = '/root/data/openipf.xlsx'
xl_file = openpyxl.load_workbook(excel_file)

# Get all sheet names
sheet_names = xl_file.sheetnames
print("=" * 60)
print("ALL SHEETS IN THE WORKBOOK:")
print("=" * 60)
for i, sheet in enumerate(sheet_names, 1):
    print(f"{i}. {sheet}")

print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("DATA SHEET - COLUMN HEADERS AND FIRST FEW ROWS:")
print("=" * 60)

# Read the Data sheet
df_data = pd.read_excel(excel_file, sheet_name='Data')
print(f"\nColumn Headers ({len(df_data.columns)} columns):")
for i, col in enumerate(df_data.columns, 1):
    print(f"  {i}. {col}")

print(f"\nShape: {df_data.shape[0]} rows x {df_data.shape[1]} columns")
print("\nFirst 5 rows:")
print(df_data.head())

print("\n" + "=" * 60)
print("DOTS SHEET - CHECKING FOR DATA:")
print("=" * 60)

try:
    df_dots = pd.read_excel(excel_file, sheet_name='Dots')
    print(f"\nShape: {df_dots.shape[0]} rows x {df_dots.shape[1]} columns")
    if df_dots.shape[0] > 0:
        print(f"\nColumn Headers:")
        for i, col in enumerate(df_dots.columns, 1):
            print(f"  {i}. {col}")
        print(f"\nFirst 5 rows:")
        print(df_dots.head())
    else:
        print("The 'Dots' sheet is empty (no data rows).")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error reading 'Dots' sheet: {e}")

EOF
